tracks.title: Monkeys Spinning Monkeys
tracks.description: Loopable happy light fluffy piece with bright flutes and a bunch of pizzicato strings.

tracks.title: Sneaky Snitch
tracks.description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly. In the final minute, the string quartet plays a simple rhythm, before the oboe and snare drum crescendo to the finale.

tracks.title: Fluffing a Duck
tracks.instruments: Tuba, Flute, Trombones, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Percussion
tracks.description: A trombone plays a humorous melody alongside timpanis and a variety of woodwind instruments. This music is suited for a short theme for a comedic piece that relies on visual jokes.  2 Small versions in one file.
